data.description:
For installation, extract to any folder (except the server folder) and run SPT-AKI Profile Editor.exe

Changes:

  • Migrated to .NET 9.0;
  • Restored the ability to use the helper mod;
  • Fixed localization for voices and traders;
  • Updated the server folder selection help dialog;
  • Added the ability to delete/cancel running crafts in the hideout
  • Due to issues with Visual Studio 2026 and the installer creation add-on, the current version (and possibly subsequent ones) will be distributed as a portable release.

To install, unzip the downloaded archive and run setup.exe

Changes:

Migration to SPT-AKI 3.8.0 (previous server versions are no longer compatible)

Fixed display of daily and weekly quests as modified

Added the ability to delete quests from profile

Added the ability to remove studied items from profile

To install, unzip the downloaded archive and run setup.exe

Changes:

Migration to SPT 3.9.0 (previous server versions are no longer compatible)

Adding missing quests to the profile has been moved from the settings to the “Quests” tab

Added Japanese language (by Lomenot)

Fixed formatting change when saving profile (#151)

To install, unzip the downloaded archive and run setup.exe

Changes:

Migration to SPT 3.10.5 (previous server versions are no longer compatible).

Minor changes to the application settings screen.

Fixed loading the list of available crafts in the hideout.

Fixed setting the flea market reputation.

Fixed infinite change of the PMC level when saving seasonal quests.

Correctly improving hideout zones that have storage.

Fix for loading of empty profiles.

Fixed a bug with the Japanese localization.

Reworking the “Fast mode”.

A note about the presence of special slots has been added to the list of pockets.

To install, unzip the downloaded archive and run setup.exe

Changes:

Migration to SPT 3.11.0 (previous server versions are no longer compatible).

Fix for saving hideout levels

Updating the helper mod (if it gives an error when starting the server, update it manually in the editor settings)

To install, unzip the downloaded archive and run setup.exe

Changes:

Migration to SPT 3.11.2 (previous server versions are no longer compatible).

Fix loading/saving clothes in profile

To install, unzip the downloaded archive and run setup.exe

Changes: Migration to SPT 4.0.1 (previous server versions are no longer compatible). The ability to use an auxiliary mod has been disabled.
